scope: Standards tab row 11 (energy): the band edges and range high P11:AP11, the descriptions L11 and N11 and M11, with C11 a number or a message, with and without entries in G11 and I11 (Sean, 20 Oct 2026: row 11 option A, AP11 included).
computed_with: nextbuild/eval/sheval_next.py 2026-10-20.1 on the candidate; every expected value of L11, M11, N11 and P11:AP11 equals ai1/tools/gen_row11_cases.py model(), written from the spec's rule and the band design
conformance: A Python, Rust or other implementation of the row 11 rule must reproduce 'expected' for every case. Inputs not listed keep the candidate's own values (the export's inputs, H3:I3 cleared).
